cards.name: Solosis
cards.notes: Added from curator-provided metadata. Solosis is drifting in a sunlit creek, tucked inside its protective membrane beneath a rainbow.
cards.whyItBelongs: Cozy nap drifting in a sunlit creek. After using "Rollout" to tumble like a bouncy jelly cushion through the wildflowers, Solosis plopped right by the brook to snooze peacefully inside its protective membrane while a delicate rainbow shimmers in the ripples below. Despite flavor text warning it can blast attackers away with psychic power, this tiny cell would clearly rather nap in the sunshine; giving LINNE’s pastel storybook art peak cozy-binder charm.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.notes: Panpour from Black Bolt 101/86 is included in this guide as a sleepy Pokemon card for collectors building a calm, cozy, or nap-themed binder. As an Illustration Rare, it has the kind of full-art presence that works especially well as a visual anchor in a themed binder layout. The card is illustrated by Hoshino KURO, which is useful context for collectors who like arranging pages by artist as well as by Pokemon. It sits in a comfortable mid-budget range, making it a nice upgrade from bulk cards without feeling like a major chase. It fits especially well in a modern Scarlet & Violet-era binder page built around soft, restful, or cozy card art.
cards.whyItBelongs: Cozy nap nestled in tropical blooms. Hoshino KURO frames the sound asleep water monkey with radiant, lush jungle foliage.

cards.name: Munna
cards.notes: Suggested by the Sleepy Pokemon community. Two Pidove are tucked into the ledge beneath Munna's dreamy pink twilight.
cards.whyItBelongs: Munna floats through a dreamy pink twilight under a crescent moon, radiating sweet dreams with its 'Rest' attack. Down in the foreground, two little Pidoves are cuddled together on the ledge, sound asleep with eyes softly shut. A quiet, poetic Unova bedtime scene.
